title: Totally unsuitable for French fries
text: Totally unsuitable for French fries. Difficult to clean because the liner that holds the oil doesn't remove. The temperature of the oil drops greatly because it holds only 1 liter of oil and has a slow recovery time. It works fine for small batches of oysters, clam strips and popcorn shrimp but is totally unsuitable for French fries and It's too small for corn dogs.

features: Adjustable thermostat for easy selection of the desired frying temperature. Oil capacity: 1 Liter ( 1.1 quarts).
